relevance_note: Case report of one family with a heterozygous TNFAIP3 deletion: '拷贝数变异分析发现先证者及其父亲存在TNFAIP3外显子2~9杂合缺失'; the Discussion also gives individual-level facts on previously published HA20/TNFAIP3 carriers.
method_note: Read the paper (Chinese full text, no tables, no supplementary text; 附表1 listing the 19 literature CNV patients is not included in the file) and wrote the JSON with a Python script in scratch; every value was entered by hand from my reading, and the script only checks spans, fields and enums. In scope: proband Ⅲ-4, his father Ⅱ-4 (carrier), his mother (tested by WES/CNV analysis; the paper reports the deletion only in the proband and father but never states her result explicitly), and previously published people given individual-level facts in the Discussion: ref ［6］ patient (same variant), ref ［7］ patient (adult onset; variant not printed), Zhang ref ［9］ girl and her carrier mother, and two brothers from an HA20 family in the Japanese survey ref ［20］ (no variant printed and no TNFAIP3 variant explicitly attributed, so no variant rows). Other family members ('家系中其他成员无发热...但未进行基因检测') and group counts (19 CNV patients, 54 survey patients) get no rows. Variant type/zygosity for ref ［6］ patient and the mother of ref ［9］ patient come from the paper's statement that they carry the same variant as the described one. No ACMG codes are printed. qPCR exon quantification confirms the deletion and is not recorded as functional evidence. Age 3岁4个月 is the proband's age at presentation (2024-01-11), with 1.5 years of follow-up after, so it is not recorded as age at last evaluation; no age at diagnosis is stated. Vital status is not stated explicitly for anyone (left not reported). Time-specific absences: proband had recurrent oral ulcers but '口腔黏膜未见溃疡' at admission, and no ulcers on follow-up colonoscopy after treatment; both recorded as excluded rows with timing in severity_or_detail, and the checklist keeps the history (observed), since these are different time points rather than a contradiction. Possible internal inconsistency: father's endoscopy says '慢性非萎缩性胃炎' but pathology says '轻度慢性萎缩性胃炎'; both rows emitted. Father's ESR 28, CRP 9.67 and calprotectin 176 have no reference range or interpretation for him, so not recorded as abnormal. Normal liver/kidney function and narrow absences (no rash, superficial nodes not enlarged) do not exclude the broader checklist items. Older brother's '严重神经系统症状' not mapped to CNS involvement (central vs peripheral not stated).
